title: Do LiDAR Language Models Really Understand Spatio-temporal Relationships?
abstract: arXiv:2609.24452v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent 4D LiDAR language models aim to reason about objects and their evolving spatial relationships. Yet, in our evaluation, always selecting the same option nearly matches the multiple-choice accuracy of two B4DL-derived configurations. We introduce LiDAR-Hallu, a geometry-referenced benchmark and diagnostic protocol with 10,000 questions across 150 nuScenes scenes. It covers object existence, ego-relative position, distance ordering, relative motion, and temporal localization, with explicit rules for selecting objects, comparing times, and determining reference answers. Our protocol combines fixed-answer and candidate-content controls, cross-scene pairs with identical prompts but opposite reference answers, and relation-specific recall. translated_title: 激光雷达语言模型真的理解时空关系吗？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.24452v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：近期的4D激光雷达语言模型旨在对物体及其不断演变的空间关系进行推理。然而，在我们的评估中，始终选择同一选项几乎就能达到两种基于B4DL派生配置的多选题准确率。我们提出了LiDAR-Hallu，这是一个以几何为参照的基准测试和诊断协议，包含覆盖150个nuScenes场景的10,000个问题。它涵盖物体存在性、相对于自车的位置、距离排序、相对运动以及时间定位，并为选择物体、比较时间和确定参考答案制定了明确的规则。我们的协议结合了固定答案控制与候选内容控制、提示相同但参考答案相反的跨场景配对问题，以及针对特定关系的召回率评估。对100,000条记录响应的分析揭示了被总体准确率所掩盖的失败。仅凭候选答案的持续时间，无需观察激光雷达数据即可预测时间类问题的答案。在配对问题上，该模……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出几何参照基准LiDAR-Hallu，通过覆盖150个nuScenes场景的10,000个诊断性问题，揭示现有4D激光雷达语言模型并未真正理解时空关系，其表面上的总体准确率掩盖了系统性的推理失败。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LiDAR-Hallu, a geometry-referenced benchmark with 10,000 diagnostic questions across 150 nuScenes scenes, revealing that existing 4D LiDAR language models do not genuinely understand spatio-temporal relationships, as aggregate accuracy masks systematic reasoning failures.
